title: Community Rules
subtitle: Please follow these rules to keep {appName} a fun and welcoming place for everyone.

accounts.title: Account Rules
accounts.content:
• One account per person — no alt accounts
• Do not share your account with others
• Use your real DDNet nickname for verification
• Do not impersonate other players or staff

fairPlay.title: Fair Play
fairPlay.content:
• No cheating or exploiting bugs in bingo/race games
• Do not use bots or automated tools to complete maps
• Report any bugs or exploits through the support system
• Respect the competitive integrity of all game modes

communication.title: Chat & Forum Rules
communication.content:
• Be respectful to other players
• No harassment, hate speech, or discrimination
• No spamming or flooding in chat/forums
• Keep discussions on-topic in their respective categories
• No advertising or self-promotion without permission

content.title: Content Guidelines
content.content:
• No NSFW or inappropriate content
• No sharing of personal information of others
• Forum posts and articles must be constructive
• Do not post malicious links or files

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.content:
Violations may result in:
• Warning from moderators
• Temporary mute or ban
• Permanent account suspension

The severity of the action depends on the nature and frequency of the violation. Moderator decisions are final.

community.title: Community Spirit
community.content:
• Help new players and answer questions
• Contribute positively to discussions
• Report rule violations through the support system
• Have fun and enjoy the DDNet community!

bingo.title: Bingo Game Rules
bingo.content:
• Each bingo game consists of a grid of DDNet maps
• Complete a map in-game to mark the corresponding cell
• Win conditions depend on the game settings: line, diagonal, or full house
• In competitive mode, the first player to complete the win condition wins
• In solo mode, complete the board at your own pace
• Map completions are verified automatically through DDNet servers
• Do not use any external tools or exploits to fake map completions
• Leaving a competitive game in progress counts as a forfeit

race.title: Race Game Rules
race.content:
• Each race consists of a path of DDNet maps to complete in order
• Complete maps as fast as possible — time is tracked automatically
• In competitive mode, the first player to finish the entire path wins
• In solo mode, try to beat your personal best time
• Map completions are verified automatically through DDNet servers
• You must complete maps in the given order — skipping is not allowed
• Do not use any external tools or exploits to fake completions
• Leaving a competitive race in progress counts as a forfeit

footer: These rules may be updated. Check back periodically for changes.
